**[SenSoft: Shack-Hartmann Analysis Software](/all-products/wavefront-sensor-software)**

SenSoft is our comprehensive software package for hardware control, Shack-Hartmann image analysis, and full optical diagnostics (from DUV to LWIR).

**Key Highlights:**
- **Precision:** 1nm rms on the wavefront.
- **Zernike Polynomials:** Supports Annular, Standard, Fringe, and Seidel (over 50 terms).
- **Advanced Output:** Computes MTF and M² directly from Shack-Hartmann data with **no scanning system required**.
- **Diagnostics:** Auto-suggests corrections for defocus/coma, detects mounting problems, and averages frames to reduce air turbulence noise.

[Explore SenSoft Capabilities](/all-products/wavefront-sensor-software) | [Download Brochure](/assets/brochures/all-products/SpotOptics-Sensoft.pdf)

**[SenSoft Simulation Packages](/all-products/wavefront-sensor-software)**

SenSoft can be upgraded with three optional simulation modules for advanced research and learning:

1. **Learning SH Analysis:** Create artificial Shack-Hartmann frames from selected aberrations to learn about the system.
2. **Telescope Design Theory:** Quick analytical design of Cassegrain or Gregorian telescopes (without ray tracing).
3. **Diffraction Theory:** Compute theoretical MTF, PSF, and EE (including seeing/pixel errors) to compare with actual SH analysis.

[Learn more about SenSoft Simulations](/all-products/wavefront-sensor-software)

Our optical metrology systems are used across multiple industries. Here are our 4 main applications:

1. [Head-Up Display Test with OMI](/applications?app=head-up-display-test) - Production line testing of automotive Heads-Up Displays (HUD) using the OMI sensor and SenSoft software.
2. [Testing Lenses with Optino: Measure Stress Due to Lens Mounting](/applications?app=optino-lens-stress-test) - Evaluate stress-induced aberrations and wavefront deformations in ophthalmic lenses caused by mounting or clamping.
3. [Astronomical Telescope Test with Puntino: Measure Stress Due to Supports](/applications?app=telescope-mirror-test) - Analyze large telescope mirrors with annular pupils to measure surface stress and wavefront deformations due to supports.
4. [Digital Camera Lens Test: On-Axis and Off-Axis Test](/applications?app=digital-camera-lens-test) - On-axis and off-axis testing of digital camera lenses and microscope objectives to analyze aberrations, wavefront, and MTF.

Our solutions are used across various optical metrology applications. Tell me more about what you need to test.

**[Head-Up Display Test with OMI](/applications?app=head-up-display-test)** 

We provide solutions for testing HUDs directly on the production line (e.g., for the automotive industry). Using our [OMI](/all-products/omi-test-in-single-pass) wavefront sensor and customized [SenSoft](/all-products/wavefront-sensor-software) software, the system communicates directly with production machines in a closed loop for real-time quality control and Zernike analysis.

[View All Applications](/applications) | [Request a Quote](/contact)

**[Testing Lenses: Stress Due to Mounting](/applications?app=optino-lens-stress-test)** 

Using our [Optino](/all-products/optino-single-and-double-pass) sensor and [SenSoft](/all-products/wavefront-sensor-software) software, we can measure stress generated by lens mountings (like a 3-point clamp) on ophthalmic lenses. The software can mathematically isolate and analyze specific aberrations like Astigmatism and Triangular Coma caused by mechanical stress.

[View All Applications](/applications) | [Request a Quote](/contact)

**[Astronomical Telescope Test with Puntino](/applications?app=telescope-mirror-test)** 

Our [Puntino](/all-products/puntino-dual-channel-for-astronomical-telescopes) wavefront sensor and [SenSoft](/all-products/wavefront-sensor-software) software are ideal for analyzing large telescope mirrors (e.g., 1.5m mirrors). Because telescopes have annular pupils, SenSoft supports Annular Zernike polynomials to accurately measure surface stress and deformations caused by mirror supports, detecting details as small as 268 nm.

[View All Applications](/applications) | [Request a Quote](/contact)

**[Digital Camera Lens Testing](/applications?app=digital-camera-lens-test)** 

We use systems like [5Star](/all-products/5star-off-axis-multi-camera) and [Stella](/all-products/sfera-and-stella-off-axis-motorized) to test digital camera lenses and microscope objectives.

- **[5Star](/all-products/5star-off-axis-multi-camera):** Analyzes lenses on-axis and off-axis simultaneously across multiple points without mechanical scanning.
- **[Stella](/all-products/sfera-and-stella-off-axis-motorized):** Uses automated macros for multi-point scanning to generate low and high-order aberration maps.
